tasks.subject: Task 1: Project Scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Initialize the project with package.json, .gitignore, and directory structure.

**Files:**
- Create: `package.json`
- Create: `.gitignore`
- Create: `src/` directory

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `npm install` succeeds without errors
- [ ] Dependencies installed: rss-parser, @anthropic-ai/sdk, nodemailer
- [ ] `node --check index.js` passes (even with empty file)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "npm install && node -e \"require('rss-parser'); require('@anthropic-ai/sdk'); require('nodemailer'); console.log('OK')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["npm install succeeds", "Dependencies installed", "node --check index.js passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Config Module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Centralize all configuration — news sources, email settings, AI API params — read from env vars where sensitive.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/config.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Exports `sources` array with 5 RSS feeds (name, url, lang)
- [ ] Exports `email` object with from/to/smtp using env vars
- [ ] Exports `anthropic` object with baseURL/apiKey/model from env vars
- [ ] Exports `maxArticlesPerSource` (3) and `maxTotalArticles` (10)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/config.js"], "verifyCommand": "node -e \"const c = require('./src/config'); console.log(c.sources.length, c.maxTotalArticles)\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Exports 5 RSS sources", "Exports email config from env vars", "Exports anthropic config from env vars", "Exports maxArticlesPerSource=3, maxTotalArticles=10"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: RSS Fetch Module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fetch RSS feeds from all configured sources, parse articles, deduplicate by URL, return top N.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/fetch.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `fetchAll()` returns array of articles with `{title, url, source, lang, rawContent}`
- [ ] Each source limited to `maxArticlesPerSource` (3)
- [ ] Total limited to `maxTotalArticles` (10)
- [ ] Deduplicates by URL
- [ ] Single source failure does not crash entire fetch

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/fetch.js"], "verifyCommand": "node -e \"const {fetchAll} = require('./src/fetch'); fetchAll().then(a => console.log(a.length, a[0].title))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Returns articles with title, url, source, lang, rawContent", "Per-source limit of 3 articles", "Total limit of 10 articles", "Deduplicates by URL", "Single source failure does not crash"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: AI Summarize Module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Call DeepSeek Anthropic API to translate/summarize each article into Chinese (≤50 chars) with a category tag, preserving English technical terms.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/summarize.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `summarizeAll(articles)` returns articles enriched with `{tag, summary}`
- [ ] Chinese sources are condensed, not re-translated
- [ ] English sources are translated to Chinese with tech terms preserved
- [ ] API failure on one article skips that item with fallback, does not crash batch

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/summarize.js"], "verifyCommand": "node -e \"const {summarizeAll} = require('./src/summarize'); summarizeAll([{title:'GPT-5 released',rawContent:'OpenAI announced GPT-5 with video reasoning',lang:'en',url:'http://x.com',source:'Test'}]).then(r => console.log(r[0]))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Returns articles enriched with tag and summary", "Chinese sources condensed only", "English sources translated with tech terms preserved", "API failure falls back, does not crash"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Email HTML Template
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generate the HTML email body from summarized articles with proper styling.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/template.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `buildEmail(articles, date)` returns valid HTML string
- [ ] Each article rendered with tag badge, title, summary, source link
- [ ] `buildSubject(date)` returns formatted subject line
- [ ] Footer contains crawl timestamp

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/template.js"], "verifyCommand": "node -e \"const {buildEmail,buildSubject} = require('./src/template'); const h = buildEmail([{title:'Test',summary:'test',tag:'产品发布',url:'http://x.com',source:'Test'}], new Date()); console.log(h.includes('产品发布'), h.includes('Test'), buildSubject(new Date()).includes('AI 新闻早报'))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["buildEmail returns valid HTML", "Articles rendered with tag, title, summary, link", "buildSubject returns formatted subject", "Footer has crawl timestamp"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Main Entry Point
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Orchestrate the full pipeline — fetch → summarize → build email → send.

**Files:**
- Create: `index.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Running `node index.js` executes the full pipeline
- [ ] Each step logs progress to console
- [ ] Errors are caught and logged, process exits with code 1 on failure
- [ ] Works end-to-end with valid env vars

```json:metadata
{"files": ["index.js"], "verifyCommand": "node index.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Executes full pipeline: fetch→summarize→email→send", "Each step logs progress", "Errors caught, exits code 1", "End-to-end works with valid env vars"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: GitHub Actions Workflow
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Schedule the script to run daily at 9:00 AM Beijing time via GitHub Actions, with manual trigger support.

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/daily.yml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Cron schedule: `0 1 * * *` (UTC 1:00 = Beijing 9:00)
- [ ] `workflow_dispatch` allows manual trigger from Actions tab
- [ ] All 6 secrets passed as env vars
- [ ] Uses Node.js 24, runs `npm ci` then `node index.js`

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/daily.yml"], "verifyCommand": "git push origin main && gh run list --workflow=daily.yml --limit 1", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Cron schedule 0 1 * * * (9am Beijing)", "workflow_dispatch manual trigger", "All 6 secrets passed as env vars", "Uses Node.js 24 with npm ci"]}
```
